name: Model and skill routing
summary: Pick which declared lane or skill a task should run on.

input.state: The task description followed by the lanes or skills as named options.

route.instructions: The lane or skill best suited to this task.

criteria.none: No declared option fits; do not route.

uncertainty.abstain: the 'none' residual is the abstain - a task no lane fits is not forced onto one
uncertainty.refusal: a refused task reports refused and takes the caller's default lane

limits: Selects among supplied candidates only - it cannot invent a lane that was not declared.
Routing is admission, not execution - the caller's permit still decides what runs.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
